scenario: a misunderstanding or problem involving phone calls
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Misunderstanding or Problem Involving Phone Calls
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: phone calls — a misunderstanding or problem involving phone calls
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a misunderstanding or problem involving phone calls; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Mr Henry tells Ms Lan the call keeps dropping.
context_note_vi: Anh Henry nói với chị Lan cuộc gọi cứ bị rớt mạng.

turns.speaker: Mr Henry
turns.english: Lan, sorry, the call keeps dropping.
turns.vietnamese: Lan này, xin lỗi, cuộc gọi cứ bị rớt mạng.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: I am having the same problem.
turns.vietnamese: Tôi cũng gặp vấn đề y vậy.

turns.speaker: Mr Henry
turns.english: Let me try a different network.
turns.vietnamese: Để tôi thử mạng khác xem.
